Category.Name: SequencerControl
Category.ToolTip: Contains parameters to control the sequencer.
Category.Description: Contains parameters to control the sequencer, e.g. enabling/disabling the sequencer, establishing individual sequence sets, storing and loading them, defining the mode to advance from one set to the next, and setting the source to control the advance.

Enumeration.Name: SequencerMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets whether the sequencer can be used for image acquisition.
Enumeration.Description: Sets whether the sequencer can be used for image acquisition.

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The sequencer can not be used for image acquisition.
EnumEntry.Description: The sequencer can not be used for image acquisition. The sequencer can now be configured (by setting SequencerConfigurationMode to On).

EnumEntry.Name: On
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The sequencer can be used for image acquisition.
EnumEntry.Description: The sequencer can be used for image acquisition. SequencerConfigurationMode must be set to Off before setting this parameter to On.

Integer.Name: SequencerSetActive
Integer.ToolTip: Index number of the currently active sequencer set.
Integer.Description: Index number of the current sequencer set, i.e. of the sequencer set whose parameter values are currently present in the active set.

Enumeration.Name: SequencerConfigurationMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets whether the sequencer can be configured.
Enumeration.Description: Sets whether the sequencer can be configured.

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The sequencer can not be configured.
EnumEntry.Description: The sequencer can not be configured. The sequencer can now be used for image acquisition (by setting SequencerMode to On).

EnumEntry.Name: On
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The sequencer can be configured.
EnumEntry.Description: The sequencer can be configured. SequencerMode must be set to Off before setting this parameter to On.

Integer.Name: SequencerSetStart
Integer.ToolTip: Sequencer set that will be used with the first frame start trigger after SequencerMode was set to On.
Integer.Description: Sequencer set that will be used with the first frame start trigger after SequencerMode was set to On. Only sequencer set 0 is available.

Integer.Name: SequencerSetSelector
Integer.ToolTip: Sets a sequencer set by its index number.
Integer.Description: Sets a sequencer set by its index number.

Command.Name: SequencerSetLoad
Command.ToolTip: Loads the parameter values of a sequencer set into the active set.
Command.Description: Loads the parameter values of a sequencer set into the active set. The sequencer set will then be the current set.

Command.Name: SequencerSetSave
Command.ToolTip: Saves the sequencer parameter values that are currently in the active set.
Command.Description: Saves the sequencer parameter values that are currently in the active set. The values will be saved for the sequencer set whose sequencer set index number is currently selected.

Integer.Name: SequencerPathSelector
Integer.ToolTip: Sets the sequencer path.
Integer.Description: Sets the sequencer path.

Integer.Name: SequencerSetNext
Integer.ToolTip: Next sequencer set to follow after the current one.
Integer.Description: Next sequencer set to follow after the current one.

Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the binning horizontal mode.

EnumEntry.ToolTip: The values of the binned pixels are summed.

EnumEntry.ToolTip: The values of the binned pixels are averaged.
EnumEntry.Description: The values of the binned pixels are averaged. This increases the signal-to-noise ratio without changing the camera's response to light.

Integer.ToolTip: Number of adjacent horizontal pixels to be summed.
Integer.Description: Number of adjacent horizontal pixels to be summed. Their charges will be summed and reported out of the camera as a single pixel.

Enumeration.Name: BinningVerticalMode

Enumeration.Description: Sets the binning vertical mode.

Integer.Name: DecimationHorizontal
Integer.ToolTip: Horizontal decimation factor.
Integer.Description: Horizontal decimation factor. It specifies the extent of horizontal sub-sampling of the acquired frame, i.e. it defines how many pixel columns are left out of transmission. This has the net effect of reducing the horizontal resolution (width) of the image by the specified decimation factor. A value of 1 indicates that the camera performs no horizontal decimation.

Integer.Name: DecimationVertical
Integer.ToolTip: Vertical decimation factor.
Integer.Description: Vertical decimation factor. It specifies the extent of vertical sub-sampling of the acquired frame, i.e. it defines how many rows are left out of transmission. This has the net effect of reducing the vertical resolution (height) of the image by the specified decimation factor. A value of 1 indicates that the camera performs no vertical decimation.

Enumeration.Name: GainAuto
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the operation mode of the gain auto function.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the operation mode of the gain auto function. The gain auto function automatically adjusts the gain within set limits until a target brightness value is reached.

EnumEntry.Name: Off
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The gain auto function is disabled.
EnumEntry.Description: The gain auto function is disabled.

EnumEntry.Name: Once
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Gain is adjusted automatically until it reaches a specific target value.

EnumEntry.Name: Continuous
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Gain is adjusted repeatedly while images are acquired.
EnumEntry.Description: Gain is adjusted repeatedly while images are acquired. The repeated automatic adjustment will proceed until the Once mode of operation is used or until the auto function is set to Off.

Converter.Name: NoiseReduction
Converter.ToolTip: Amount of noise reduction to apply.
Converter.Description: Amount of noise reduction to apply. The higher the value, the less chroma noise will be visible in your images. However, too high values may result in image information loss. To enable this feature, the DemosaicingMode parameter must be set to BaslerPGI.

Converter.Name: SharpnessEnhancement
Converter.ToolTip: Amount of sharpening to apply.
Converter.Description: Amount of sharpening to apply. The higher the sharpness, the more distinct the image subject's contours will be. However, too high values may result in image information loss. To enable this feature, the DemosaicingMode parameter must be set to BaslerPGI.

Enumeration.Name: FileOperationSelector
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the target operation for the currently selected file.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the target operation for the currently selected file. After an operation has been selected, the operation can be executed using the FileOperationExecute command.

EnumEntry.Name: Open
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The currently selected file can be opened.
EnumEntry.Description: The currently selected file can be opened. The access mode in which the file is opened can be set using the FileOpenMode parameter.

EnumEntry.Name: Close
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The currently selected file can be closed.
EnumEntry.Description: The currently selected file can be closed.

EnumEntry.Name: Read
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The currently selected file can be read.
EnumEntry.Description: The currently selected file can be read. When the FileOperationExecute command is executed, the camera reads FileAccessLength bytes from the device storage at the file relative offset FileAccessOffset into FileAccessBuffer.

EnumEntry.Name: Write
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The currently selected file can be written.
EnumEntry.Description: The currently selected file can be written. When the FileOperationExecute command is executed, the camera writes FileAccessLength bytes taken from the FileAccessBuffer into the device storage at the file relative offset FileAccessOffset.

Enumeration.Name: FileOpenMode
Enumeration.ToolTip: Sets the access mode in which a file is opened in the device.
Enumeration.Description: Sets the access mode in which a file is opened in the device.

EnumEntry.Name: Read
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Files are opened in read-only mode.
EnumEntry.Description: Files are opened in read-only mode.

EnumEntry.Name: Write
EnumEntry.ToolTip: Files are opened in write-only mode.
EnumEntry.Description: Files are opened in write-only mode.

Integer.Name: FileAccessOffset
Integer.ToolTip: File access offset.
Integer.Description: File access offset. Controls the mapping between the device file storage and the FileAccessBuffer.

Integer.Name: FileAccessLength
Integer.ToolTip: File access length.
Integer.Description: File access length. Controls the mapping between the device file storage and the FileAccessBuffer.

Enumeration.Name: FileOperationStatus
Enumeration.ToolTip: Returns the file operation execution status.
Enumeration.Description: Returns the file operation execution status.

EnumEntry.Name: Success
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The file operation was successful.
EnumEntry.Description: The file operation was successful.

EnumEntry.Name: Failure
EnumEntry.ToolTip: The file operation has failed.
EnumEntry.Description: The file operation has failed.

Integer.Name: FileOperationResult
Integer.ToolTip: File operation result.
Integer.Description: File operation result. For read or write operations, the number of successfully read/written bytes is returned.

Integer.Name: FileSize
Integer.ToolTip: Size of the currently selected file in bytes.
Integer.Description: Size of the currently selected file in bytes.

Command.Name: FileOperationExecute
Command.ToolTip: Executes the operation selected by FileOperationSelector.
Command.Description: Executes the operation selected by FileOperationSelector on the selected file.
